title: Display & graphics diagnostics
tips: `system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType` lists connected displays and GPU state.
Black screen on external monitor is often EDID / handshake — try a different cable or port.
GPU hangs appear as brief freezes then recovery; check Console for IOAccelerator messages.
Scaled resolutions (HiDPI) can look soft or fail on older displays.
True Tone and Night Shift rarely cause black screens but can confuse brightness complaints.
